root_cause: Text.append(text) and Text.append_text(text) do self._spans.extend(_Span(...) for ... in text._spans). When text is self, the generator iterates the same list that extend() is growing, so every appended span yields another span and the loop never terminates (unbounded memory growth).
best_solution: Snapshot the source spans before extending: iterate over text._spans.copy() (or tuple/list of it) in BOTH Text.append (the Text branch) and Text.append_text. The self-alias case then copies the original N spans once, giving plain 'oneone' with doubled spans. The statement only says 'infinite loop in append'; the issue shows a.append(a). Grepping rich/text.py for the identical 'extend(... for ... in text._spans)' pattern finds the second site in append_text, which the hidden test also exercises.
hidden_test_demands: tests/test_text.py::test_append_loop_regression: a=Text('one','blue'); a.append(a); a.plain=='oneone'; and b=Text('two','blue'); b.append_text(b); b.plain=='twotwo'. Both methods must terminate on self-append; an unfixed append_text hangs the test run (timeout, empty log).
locating_signals: Title 'fix infinite loop in append' names Text.append only; the linked issue #3479 (not in statement body, only its URL) gives repro a.append(a). append_text is NOT named anywhere in the statement; it is found only by searching for the same aliasing pattern (self._spans.extend over text._spans) in rich/text.py.
our_outcome_summary: All four configs failed in the Kaggle env. v4: produced only a new reproduce_issue.py (no source change); pod run 555s, the repro likely hung on the infinite loop. v6 and v7: empty patches (366s each). v8: correct fix in Text.append (tuple(text._spans)) but did not touch the identical pattern in Text.append_text, so the hidden test's b.append_text(b) still loops forever and the test run times out (empty test log); it also added a stray tests/test_append_self.py.
generalizable_lesson: When fixing a bug caused by a code pattern (here: extending a list while iterating an alias of it), grep the whole module for every other occurrence of the same pattern and fix sibling methods too (append vs append_text, add vs add_all, sync vs async variants); hidden regression tests often cover the siblings. Also, when the bug is a hang, always run the repro under a timeout (e.g. `timeout 10 python repro.py`) so the agent's own budget is not consumed by the infinite loop, and do not ship repro scripts as part of the patch.
acceptable_alternatives: Any snapshot of text._spans before extend (list(text._spans), tuple(text._spans), text._spans[:]), or an explicit `if text is self` branch, applied to both Text.append and Text.append_text.
